pieces.Text: you have developed the formula for a superserum that can create powerful changes in a target. You can create two superserums per day. Your superserums are a special type of biohack, and you prepare them as part of the 10 minutes required to create your normal biohacks for the day. Your superserum produces one of the following effects: Grant major healing or bring a dead creature back to life, Scramble the physiological makeup of the target, causing massive internal damage, Relieve the target of debilitating conditions.
